body.contents: The Field Guide is most plainly, Your guide through the Wizarding World. Here, You can bind spells to the spell wheel, complete quests, and even unlock new abilities.
As of beta 4, the only page that is complete is the Spell Wheel page and Settings Page, The top most right Icon. There you can customize the spell wheel to your preference.
You can find this message and others (like Recipes) inisde the Settings Page in the Field Guide.
